data.name: Profile_CommuteHelp
data.value: Enter your home address – we compute the distance to the lot from it. The farther you live, the more points you earn for taking a freed spot.

data.value: You don't have enough credits for this reservation.

data.name: Parking_Settings_EconomyHelp
data.value: Reservation price = base × peak surcharge × occupancy surcharge (capped). Credits are charged on booking and refunded on an early enough cancel or release.

data.name: Parking_Settings_QueuePenaltyHelp
data.value: Uncompromising penalty when a user claims a spot from the queue and then doesn't show up: a bigger points hit, a credit fine, a temporary queue ban and a cut to next month's allowance.

data.name: Parking_Queue_Error_Banned
data.value: You're temporarily barred from the queue because of a previous no-show.

data.name: Parking_Settings_DemandRewardHelp
data.value: The release reward grows with demand: an occupancy surcharge plus a bonus per person queued for the spot, capped. Freeing a spot that's in demand pays the most.

data.name: Parking_Settings_LoyaltyHelp
data.value: A reward for an unbroken run of completions (grows with length, capped; a no-show resets it) and the reputation thresholds for the loyalty tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) that unlock perks.

data.name: Parking_Settings_AdaptiveHelp
data.value: Self-tuning controller: it periodically measures peak occupancy and nudges the peak surcharge toward the target occupancy (within bounds, in steps). When off, the manual surcharge value stands.

data.name: Parking_Settings_TrustHelp
data.value: Builds an interaction graph from completed reservations on shared spots and computes a trust score (0–100) with a weighted PageRank. Above the threshold the "Trusted" badge is awarded. Gaming-resistant — edges require real completed reservations.

data.name: Parking_Settings_CollusionHelp
data.value: Detects pairs whose sharing interactions are too concentrated on each other (a possible farming ring) and records a flag for review. The only automatic effect is the trust-graph edge cap; hard action is left to an admin.

data.name: Parking_Collusion_Intro
data.value: Pairs whose sharing is too concentrated on each other. Review and either keep on record or dismiss as a false positive.

data.name: Parking_Settings_TierPerksHelp
data.value: Tangible perks for reputation: queue priority, a bigger monthly allowance and a reservation price discount — all growing with the loyalty tier.
